review.notes: Full OCR read-through plus whole-document normalized word-level diff against extracted text of all 23 physical PDF pages; pages 3, 5, 8, 9, 11 and 20 were additionally rendered and visually inspected (plus a 400 dpi crop of the p.9 QWQ-32B bullet). The appendix code fences are balanced: the ```txt prompt boxes legitimately contain literal ```python lines, which cannot close an info-string fence and render as printed. The A.1 labels 'Math', 'No Starter Code (Python)' and 'Has Starter Code' print as bold display lines and were left as headings. 'QWQ-32B' in the p.9 bullet, 'Chip-Higher trick' in the Figure 3 caption, 'combinatory', 'BRUMO2025', 'LiveCodebench v5/v6' and reference list casings (Deepseek-R1, Qwq-32b) reproduce the print and were not patched; '<\think>' and '``python[code]``' match the printed prompt text. Figure-internal legends (Clip-Higher, topic names, After Math/Code-RL improvements) belong to embedded figures.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.3 prints this sentence as a plain body paragraph introducing the contribution list (visually verified); it is not a section heading. The patch removes the OCR-promoted '## ' marker without changing the sentence text.

Rendered physical p.5 prints 'Reward functions:' as a bold run-in paragraph label before the verification bullets (visually verified); it is not a numbered section heading. The patch demotes the OCR heading to the printed bold paragraph.
Rendered physical p.9 Table 2 caption prints 'top_p=0.95' with a plain underscore (visually verified); the backslash is an OCR-added Markdown escape that would render a visible backslash.
